log file %s/isisd-runtime.log
interface r1-eth0
 ip router isis LAB
 isis network point-to-point
interface r1-eth1
 ip router isis LAB
 isis network point-to-point
interface r1-eth2
 ip router isis LAB
 isis network point-to-point
interface lo
 ip router isis LAB
 isis passive
router isis LAB
 net 49.0001.0000.0000.0001.00
 is-type level-2-only
 lsp-gen-interval 1
' "$d" > $d/isisd.conf; /usr/lib/frr/zebra -d -N mnr-ring-r1 -f $d/zebra.conf -i $d/zebra.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/zebra.log 2>&1; /usr/lib/frr/isisd -d -N mnr-ring-r1 -f $d/isisd.conf -i $d/isisd.pid -z $d/zserv.api >$d/isisd.log 2>&1
